# Figure 3 - HF-300 vibration severity zones

**Source:** AquaDyne_HF300_OM_Manual.pdf, page 2

## Description

A horizontal bar chart divided into four colored zones that classify vibration severity for the HF-300 by vibration velocity. Severity increases from left to right: green (Zone A), yellow-green (Zone B), orange (Zone C) and red (Zone D).

## Axis

- **X-axis label:** Vibration velocity, mm/s RMS (measured on bearing housings)
- **Axis values:** 0.0, 2.8, 4.5, 7.1, 11.0
- **Axis range shown:** 0.0 to 11.0 mm/s RMS
- **Y-axis:** none

## Zones and ranges

| Zone | Color | Range (mm/s RMS) | Label text |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zone A | Green | 0.0 to 2.8 | New machines |
| Zone B | Yellow-green | 2.8 to 4.5 | Long-term operation |
| Zone C | Orange | 4.5 to 7.1 | Restricted - plan maintenance |
| Zone D | Red | 7.1 to 11.0 (end of axis shown) | Damage likely - stop the pump |

## Thresholds (zone boundaries)

- 2.8 mm/s RMS: boundary between Zone A and Zone B
- 4.5 mm/s RMS: boundary between Zone B and Zone C
- 7.1 mm/s RMS: boundary between Zone C and Zone D

The figure does not indicate which zone a value falling exactly on a boundary belongs to.

## Callout numbers

- None present in the image.

# AquaDyne Pumps Ltd
# SERVICE BULLETIN SB-2026-014

Issued: 14 March 2026 Applies to: HF-300 pumps, serial HF3-22000 and above

Subject: Mechanical seal superseded

Field returns show early failure of component seal HF3-450 on pumps built from serial HF3-22000, caused by a revised sleeve tolerance. On these pumps:

1. Do NOT fit HF3-450. Use cartridge seal HF3-450B instead.
2. HF3-450B is pre-set: no sleeve measurement is needed.
3. Seal gland nut torque for HF3-450B is 30 Nm (was 25 Nm).
4. Replace shaft sleeve HF3-455 if scoring exceeds 0.1 mm depth.

Pumps below serial HF3-22000 continue to use HF3-450 and Table 5 of the manual.

| Item | Old part | New part | Gland torque |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mechanical seal | HF3-450 | HF3-450B | 30 Nm |

Authorised: R. Okafor, Product Engineering

5. Maintenance procedures
5.2 Mechanical seal replacement. (1) Isolate and drain the pump. (2) Remove the back pull-out assembly. (3) Remove the impeller nut and impeller. (4) Withdraw the seal and sleeve; inspect the sleeve for scoring. (5) Fit the new seal and a new casing gasket. (6) Tighten all fasteners to Table 5.
5.3 Bearing replacement. Replace both bearings as a pair when either shows wear, noise or high temperature.
5.4 Shaft alignment. Use a laser alignment tool after any work that moves the motor or the bearing housing. Tolerances: parallel offset 0.05 mm, angular 0.05 mm per 100 mm.

AquaDyne HF-300 End-Suction Centrifugal Pump
Operation & Maintenance Manual - Document AQ-OM-300, Revision D
1. Specifications
The HF-300 is a back pull-out pump: the rotating assembly can be removed without disturbing the casing or pipework. Bearing temperatures are measured on the housing surface.
